question: Does the designated Apple reviewer approve landing this shared persisted-state migration after a current-base refresh confirms that legacy import, durable outbox preservation, and gateway-scoped deletion still pass?
rationale: The product direction is already approved, but changing installation-wide durable client state has upgrade consequences that require accountable review of the final merge result.

options.title: Refresh and approve the migration
options.body: Rebase or validate the merge result, rerun the focused Apple storage proof, and approve the owner-approved two-database contract.

options.title: Pause for a narrower upgrade audit
options.body: Hold the PR if reviewers need production-backup or additional legacy-store coverage before accepting the persistence migration.

recommendation.title: Refresh and approve the migration
recommendation.body: Rebase or validate the merge result, rerun the focused Apple storage proof, and approve the owner-approved two-database contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion identifies this person as the contract decision-maker and recent contributor across the affected Apple and native-app workflow surfaces.
